svg.title: Graph proofs and envelope proofs authenticate different inputs
svg.desc: The architectures can convey the same RDF dataset. A checks a proof over the canonical quads and the canonical proof configuration. B checks a proof over the protected envelope input. In the erasure case of L2(b), B needs retained source evidence for direct verification after a merge.

rdf:Alt.rdf:li: Graph proofs and envelope proofs authenticate different inputs

The architectures can convey the same RDF dataset. A checks a proof over the canonical quads and the canonical proof configuration. B checks a proof over the protected envelope input. In the erasure case of L2(b), B needs retained source evidence for direct verification after a merge.
